summary: A request to move a movable platform (elevator, lift): an entity followed by one esv::platform::MoveRequest (0x30 bytes, the element type of the system map ls::HashMap<EntityHandle, DynamicArray<esv::platform::MoveRequest>> named in the macOS build). Consumed by esv::platform::MovementSystem::ProcessMoveRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x644CB0), which appends component+8 (FUN_180642720, element stride 0x30) to the per-platform request list. Seen.py context: level change (a platform got a scripted move on level load).
